name: qf-connect
description: Quantum Frame branded VoIP customer portal and integrations on the VoIP.ms API

scripts.dev: npm run seed -w apps/api && concurrently -n api,worker,web "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run worker -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/api
